summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K furnishing legal opinions (Exhibits 5.1 and 5.2) in connection with the issuance of US$1.25 billion of 5.099% Fixed/Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2030 under an existing F-3 shelf registration. The filing is routine debt issuance documentation, including consents and counsel opinions from Sullivan & Cromwell and Osler Hoskin Harcourt. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The registrant acted solely as issuer of debt securities, and the filing does not involve any equity-based special situation. This is an ordinary capital markets takedown.
